title: Complaint RE Moon K. Ham, et al. vs. Korean Capital Presbytery
disposition_detail: The SJC ruled Case 2001-35 administratively out of order because it dealt with allegations presented to Presbytery but was not in the form of a complaint against presbytery action or inaction. No merits determination or relief is stated.
first_summary: The SJC ruled the complaint out of order because it concerned allegations presented to Presbytery rather than a complaint against presbytery action or inaction.
summary: A complaint that presented allegations to Presbytery, rather than challenging presbytery action or inaction, was ruled administratively out of order by the Standing Judicial Commission. The SJC did not reach the merits and granted no relief. The source is a short status ruling only.
